name: 國二・二段 英文練習卷（文法選擇題）
source: 高雄楷模書院練習卷・八上英文 康／翰／南 B3 L3～L4 文法測驗

questions.q: Carol ＿＿＿ a lot of water after she exercises every day.
questions.e: 由 exercises 可知，此句為固定習慣的敘述，用現在簡單式。

questions.q: When Mr. Li shouted, the baby（嬰兒）＿＿＿.
questions.e: when 子句時態為過去式，可知主要子句的動詞時態也為過去式。

questions.q: ＿＿＿ Mr. and Mrs. Wang lost their daughter, they were sad.
questions.e: 在失去女兒「之後」非常悲傷，連接詞用 after。

questions.q: Sandy and I were classmates when ＿＿＿ in junior high school. We ＿＿＿ next to each other（彼此）for three years.
questions.e: 由 were 可知是在談論過去的事，when 須連接兩時態相同的完整子句，故第一格用 westudied；由第一句可知是指國中三年都坐在彼此隔壁，故第二格也要用過去式。

questions.q: My mom always prepares breakfast for me before I ＿＿＿ for school. She is really nice to me.
questions.e: 媽媽準備早餐為固定發生的事件，所以用現在簡單式。

questions.q: Tom, put down the chopsticks（筷子）. ＿＿＿ you eat dinner, you should ＿＿＿ your hands.
questions.e: 由叫 Tom 放下筷子可知要他在吃晚餐前先洗手，故第一格用 before；should 為助動詞，後接原形動詞，故第二格用 wash。

questions.q: When my parents ＿＿＿ young, they ＿＿＿ work and study at the same time. That was really hard.
questions.e: 由後句 was 可知，when 子句跟主要子句也發生於過去時間，be 動詞的過去式為 were，have to 的過去式為 had to，must 的過去式也為 had to。

questions.q: We practiced basketball for one hour ＿＿＿ then talked for another（另一個的）hour ＿＿＿Jay arrived（到達）. That is, he was two hours late.
questions.e: 由第二句 two hours late 可知，在 Jay 到達之前，已先練習一小時的籃球跟講了一小時的話，故第一格用 and，第二格用 before。

questions.q:
A：Ivy ＿＿＿ to our house ＿＿＿ you went to bed last night.
B：Really? Why didn’t you wake me up then?
questions.e: 由 didn’t you wake me up 可知，昨晚 Ivy 來時 B 已經睡覺，故第一格用 came，第二格用after。

questions.q: Before Timothy went to the movies, he ＿＿＿ the computer for me. I really thanked him.
questions.e: Before 子句時態為過去式，可知主要子句的動詞時態也為過去式。

questions.q: Carl ＿＿＿ the flowers after he cleaned the classroom this afternoon. He did a lot for his class.
questions.e: after 子句時態為過去式，可知主要子句的動詞時態也為過去式。

questions.q:
A：Wow! James is a famous actor now.
B：Yes, he is. However, he failed many times ＿＿＿ he succeeded（成功）.
questions.e: 由「不敢相信」、「有名的演員」可知，他成功「之前」失敗很多次。

questions.q: I was playing computer games, and my sisters ＿＿＿, too.
questions.e: was playing 為過去進行式，所以 and 連接的句子時態也應相同，且主詞 my sisters 為複數，所以應選 be 動詞 were。

questions.q: Jack was writing an e-mail to his teacher ＿＿＿.
questions.e: 由 was writing 為過去進行式，可判斷是過去某個時間點正在寫電子郵件。

questions.q: Lisa was playing the guitar ＿＿＿ her friend called this morning.
questions.e: when 表「當……時」；前面子句的時態為「過去進行式」，而後面子句為「過去簡單式」，用 when 連接。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ you doing when Mom called you?
B：I ＿＿＿ playing chess with Grandfather.
questions.e: 由問句 called 可知是在談論過去發生的事，故第一格用 were，第二格用 was。

questions.q:
A：What was John ＿＿＿ then?
B：He ＿＿＿ washing his car.
questions.e: 過去進行式為「過去式 be 動詞＋V-ing」，回答也用過去式 be 動詞。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ Nancy doing when you entered?
B：She ＿＿＿ cleaning the table when I entered.
questions.e: 由 when 子句可知為過去時間，又表達過去的持續動作，用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：What were these students ＿＿＿ at six yesterday evening?
B：They ＿＿＿ basketball.
questions.e: 昨天傍晚六點那時發生的動作，用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：Did you see Eric at nine this morning?
B：Yes, he ＿＿＿ in his bedroom then.
questions.e: 由問句中 at nine this morning 可知，描述 Eric 在當時的動作應用過去進行式。

questions.q: Sorry, I didn’t answer the phone one hour ago. When you ＿＿＿, I ＿＿＿ a bath（泡澡）.
questions.e: 由第一句可知，一小時前打電話來時，說話者正在泡澡，打電話是在泡澡期間打來，故第一格用過去簡單式，第二格用過去進行式，表過去某件事正在進行時，另一件事瞬間發生。

questions.q:
A：What were you ＿＿＿ when I ＿＿＿ the house? It smelled（聞起來）delicious.
B：It was chicken curry（咖哩）. Mom made this, not me.
questions.e: 由 Mom made this, not me. 可知，A 在 B 進屋時是在吃咖哩，而非烹煮咖哩，故第一格用eating，第二格用 entered。

questions.q:
A：＿＿＿ was my dog doing when you saw it?
B：It ＿＿＿ after a cat at the playground.
questions.e: 由答句可知問句是問 B 看到 A 的狗時，牠正在做「什麼」，故第一格用 What；由問句 wasmy dog doing 可知答句也要用過去進行式，故第二格用 was running。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ you doing when your mom called?
B：I ＿＿＿ flowers when she called.
questions.e: 主要子句表達過去的持續動作，故用過去進行式。

questions.q: When I ＿＿＿ the strange noise, my dog was ＿＿＿ out of the window. However, there was nothing outside（外面）.
questions.e: 由 was 可知是在談論過去發生的事，hear 表示不經意聽到，為瞬間動作，無進行式，故第一格用 heard，第二格用 looking。

questions.q:
A：Why ＿＿＿ you ＿＿＿ at Elvis last night?
B：Because he sat on my glasses and broke（打破）them.
questions.e: 由時間副詞 last night 可知問句用過去式助動詞 did。

questions.q:
A：What was Judy doing at three yesterday afternoon?
B：She ＿＿＿.
questions.e: 時間副詞為過去式，須用過去時態。

questions.q: I was playing computer games, and my sisters ＿＿＿, too.
questions.e: was playing 為過去進行式，所以 and 連接的句子時態也應相同，且主詞 my sisters 為複數，所以應選 be 動詞 were。

questions.q:
A：What was Judy doing at three yesterday afternoon?
B：She ＿＿＿.
questions.e: 時間副詞為過去式，須用過去時態。

questions.q: When I got home, my mom ＿＿＿ in her room.
questions.e: sleep 為持續性的動作，主要子句須用過去進行式。

questions.q: Betty ＿＿＿ fake watches when the police came.【90 基測】
questions.e: 由 when the police came 得知動作發生在過去，且強調動作的持續，所以用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：Why ＿＿＿ Eddy ＿＿＿ then?
B：His wife left him, so he was very sad.
questions.e: 由時間副詞 then 可判斷，Eddy 過去某個時間點正在哭，所以用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：Why ＿＿＿ you shouting then?
B：I ＿＿＿ a terrible dream.
questions.e: 由 shouting，且答句時態為過去式，可知應搭配過去式 be 動詞 were。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ Allen ＿＿＿ at seven yesterday evening?
B：He was studying in the library.
questions.e: 由「昨晚七點」可知，問句須用過去進行式。

questions.q: Betty ＿＿＿ TV when her little brother fell off the chair.【97 基測】
questions.e: 當 Betty 在看電視的時候，她的弟弟從椅子上跌落。連接詞 when 的前後句時態須一致。而此句用過去進行式強調「弟弟從椅子上跌落當時，Betty 正在看電視」。

questions.q:
A：＿＿＿ the cute rabbit ＿＿＿ around in the park when you were there?
B：No, it wasn’t. In fact, I didn’t see it today.
questions.e: 由答句 No, it wasn’t. 可知問句為含有過去式 be 動詞的用法，動詞時態只有選項 (C) 符合。

questions.q:
A：Guess what! I met your favorite boy Larry at the gym.
B：Really? What ＿＿＿ he ＿＿＿ there? Practicing basketball?
questions.e: 由 met 及 practicing 可知，B 問 A 在體育館遇到 Larry 時他正在做什麼，故空格要用過去進行式。

questions.q: I ＿＿＿ a bath when someone turned off the light. I was scared and shouted for help.
questions.e: 由 when someone turned off the light（當某人關掉電燈）可知動作發生在過去，且為了強調動作的持續及正在進行，所以用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：You didn’t answer the phone this morning.
B：Sorry. I ＿＿＿ when you called.
questions.e: 由「今天早上」可知是過去式，又「游泳」為持續性的動作，故用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ you ＿＿＿ at 10 a.m. yesterday?
B：I was busy with work. I didn’t even（甚至）have time for lunch.
questions.e: 由 at 10 a.m. yesterday 可知是強調過去某時刻正在進行的事，故空格要用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：What ＿＿＿ your sister ＿＿＿ at 2 p.m. yesterday?
B：I don’t know. I didn’t see her until（直到）4 p.m.
questions.e: 由 at 2 p.m. yesterday 可知是強調過去某時刻正在做什麼，故空格要用過去進行式；your sister為第三人稱單數，故搭配過去式 be 動詞 was。

questions.q:
A：I went to Joe’s place two hours ago, but when I saw him, he seemed（似乎）very tired.
B：Really? ＿＿＿ was Joe doing ＿＿＿?
A：His science report（報告）.
questions.e: 由 was Joe doing 可知是強調 A 兩小時前到 Joe 家時他正在進行的動作，且由 sciencereport 可知 B 是問 Joe 當時正在做什麼，故在此兩空格皆符合的選項為 (A)。

questions.q: I couldn’t do my homework at that time because Jessie ＿＿＿ much noise. She was mopping the floor then.
questions.e: 由 at that time 可判斷 Jessie 當時在「製造」噪音，用過去進行式。

questions.q:
A：Is it three thirty now?
B：Yes, it’s ＿＿＿ three.
questions.e: 三點三十分的英文為 three thirty 或 half past three。

questions.q:
A：I usually get up at eight fifteen from Monday to Friday.
B：Do you get up at ＿＿＿ eight on weekends, too?
A：No, I usually get up at ＿＿＿ on weekends.
o: a quarter to; a quarter to nine
a quarter after; eight and a quarter
questions.e: 根據上下語意，B 詢問 A 是否週末也在八點十五分起床，所以第一個空格應為 a quarter past/ after eight；第二格空格為八點四十五分，正確說法為 eight forty-five 或 a quarter to nine。

questions.e: Before 子句時態為過去式，可知主要子句的動詞時態也為過去式。

questions.q: Carl ＿＿＿ the flowers after he cleaned the classroom this afternoon. He did a lot for his class.
questions.e: after 子句時態為過去式，可知主要子句的動詞時態也為過去式。

questions.q:
A：Wow! James is a famous actor now.
B：Yes, he is. However, he failed many times ＿＿＿ he succeeded（成功）.
questions.e: 由「不敢相信」、「有名的演員」可知，他成功「之前」失敗很多次。

questions.q: My brother and his friends like ＿＿＿ the guitar.
questions.e: 動詞 like 後面若接動詞，須以不定詞或動名詞呈現。

questions.q: Jerry wants ＿＿＿ money for a new computer.
questions.e: 動詞 want 後面若接動詞，該動詞須以不定詞的形式呈現。

questions.q:
A：It’s nice of you to help me ＿＿＿ my math homework.
B：No problem.
questions.e: 「help＋受詞＋with＋名詞」表「幫助……做……」。

questions.q: I want to ＿＿＿ Shirley. She is beautiful and smart.
questions.e: like 在此為介系詞，表「像」；to 之後應加原形 be 動詞。

questions.q:
A：Was your dog swimming when I saw you at the beach?
B：Yes, it ＿＿＿. It loves ＿＿＿ and play frisbee a lot.
questions.e: 由問句 was your dog swimming 可知答句也要用過去進行式回答，肯定簡答為 Yes, it was.；表達「喜愛做……」可用 love to V 或 love + V-ing，而 and 為對等連接詞，故在此可用 love to swimand (to) play 或 love swimming and playing。

questions.q: Sorry, I ＿＿＿ go home now because it’s 11 p.m. ＿＿＿ dangerous（危險的）to stay out late at night.
questions.e: need / have / want 後接 to V，should 為助動詞，後接原形動詞；表達「做……是……」用「It + be 動詞... + to V」，故在此兩空格皆符合的選項為 (C)。

questions.q: My sister wants ＿＿＿ a school teacher. She prepares for the test almost（幾乎）every day.
questions.e: 「want＋to be」表「想成為……」。

questions.q: My cousin loves ＿＿＿. She is especially（尤其）good at cooking beef noodles.
questions.e: 動詞 love 後面若接動詞，須以不定詞或動名詞的形式呈現。

questions.q:
A：Why ＿＿＿ you go to the party last night? Don’t you like parties?
B：Yes, I do. But I needed ＿＿＿ care of my brother because my parents weren’t home then.
questions.e: 表達「必須做……」用 need to V，故第二格用 to take；由第二句可知昨晚沒有參加派對，故第一格用 didn’t。

questions.q:
Mom：Judy, we need ＿＿＿ some water. A typhoon（颱風）is coming.
Judy：I see, Mom.
questions.e: 動詞 need 後面若接動詞，該動詞須以不定詞呈現。

questions.q: Dad always tells me not ＿＿＿ only for tests. If that’s all I’m doing, he says, I will soon lose interest in learning.
questions.e: 「A＋tell＋B＋not to＋原形動詞…」的句型表示「A 叫 B 不要做……」。

questions.q:
A：Thanks ＿＿＿ your help. Thanks ＿＿＿ you, I finished my work on time.
B：Don’t mention it（別客氣）.
questions.e: 謝謝你的幫忙，介系詞要用 for；thanks to 表「幸虧；歸功於」。

questions.q: Before Joe ＿＿＿ abroad（國外）to work, he planned ＿＿＿ English well. Now it’s easy for him to talk to foreigners（外國人）in English.
questions.e: before 連接兩相同時態的子句，由 planned 可知在談論過去的事，故第一格要用 went；表達「計畫做……」用 plan to V，故第二格用 to learn。

questions.q: ＿＿＿ your hands before meals. It’s not good ＿＿＿ with your dirty hands.
questions.e: 第一句無動詞，可知為原形動詞起首的祈使句，故第一格用 Wash；表達「做……是……」用「It + be 動詞... + to V」，故第二格用 to eat。
